scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native/resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Disability must be 40% or above for Orthopaedic, Deaf, Dumb, or Blind categories
For Mentally Retarded category, IQ must be below 69
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance ranging from ₹2000 to ₹3800, depending on disability percentage and age.
